pages.title: An Inscribable Focus
pages.text: The Magic Lens is the heart of your arcane practice. It can hold up to 5 spells, which you assign at an Inscription Workbench. Once inscribed, hold the lens and scroll to cycle between your known spells.
A simple lens, ready to be inscribed with power.
Bind a keybind to Cast Spell in your controls menu. Scroll while holding the lens to select a spell, then press your cast key to unleash it. Casting costs mana, drawn from the lens's own reserve.
